title: 1848. március 15. (March 15, 1848)
grammar: Political Declarations, Subjunctive Demands & 1848 Narrative Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what happened in Pest on 15 March 1848.
I can say what the March Youth demanded, using hogy and a subjunctive verb.
I can say what was printed without a censor's permission.
I can use six new words about 15 March 1848, such as cenzúra and sajtószabadság.
